It doesn't do a lot of damage, but it can be used to attack foes from a distance.|Allies|AoC}} Traveler's Bows go unnamed in {{SSBU}}. ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Bow |strength = 5 |durability = 22 |flammable = Yes |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = No |throw = |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Traveler's Bow}} Traveler's Bows are weak ranged [[Bow]]s commonly used by travelers for protection. Though they do not deal much damage, they can be used to attack [[Enemy|Enemies]] at a distance. They are most commonly found in [[Hyrule Field]] and [[West Necluda]], where they are either wielded by Enemies or hidden in [[Treasure Chest]]s. The following [[amiibo]] have a chance to spawn a Treasure Chest containing a Traveler's Bow when they are scanned with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]]: * {{SSB}} Series [[Zelda]] amiibo * {{BotW}} Series [[Link]] (Archer) amiibo * {{BotW|-}} Series [[Revali]] amiibo Being made of wood, Traveler's Bows are flammable, and they will therefore burn if exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. However, they are not magnetic, so they cannot be picked up with the [[Magnesis]] Rune. They do not conduct [[Electricity]] or attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s, but they will float if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]]. Traveler's Bows belong to the [[Traveler's Gear]] archetype of equipment, which are all said to be used to defend travelers throughout [[Hyrule]].{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 169}} A Traveler's Bow is part of an unnamed set of equipment used by Link in promotional media, alongside a [[Soldier's Broadsword]] and a [[Traveler's Shield]]. {{BotW Bow Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Bow_001" |Life = 22 |Power = 5 |Range = 20.0 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 3 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 5 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 4 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 7 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 6 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 8 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 8 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 13 |PoweredSharpAddSpreadFire = false |PoweredSharpAddZoomRapid = false |PoweredSharpAddRapidFireMin = 1.1 |PoweredSharpAddRapidFireMax = 1.3 |ArrowName = "" |IsLeadShot = false |LeadShotNum = 0 |LeadShotAng = 45 |IsRapidFire = false |RapidFireNum = 0 |ArrowGravity = -9.8 |ArrowChargeRate = 1.0 |ArrowReloadRate = 1.0 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Traveler's Bow}} {{Stub|TotK}} {{TotK Item Properties/Store |type = Bow |strength = 5 |durability = |flammable = |magnetic = |buoyant = |conductive = |guardian = }} Traveler's Bows are [[Bow]]s in {{TotK}}. ==Other Appearances== ==={{SSBU|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} [[Link]] uses the Traveler's Bow as his neutral special move in {{SSBU}}. Like in {{BotW}}, when Link fires an [[Arrow]], it lingers on the ground.
